messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Lena (CTO at Jericho Health) pushed back on acceptance. Key blockers: telemetry read-only access for their SIEM, explicit cross‑AZ failover behavior, and a hard cap on egress. They want a demo/trace proving failover and a telemetry sample before exec signs off.

Jordan: Quick from SE: we can stream model events via EventBridge -> Kinesis -> customer Splunk. Can redact PII at source. Sample payload below.
```
{
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "model": "redwood-3b",
  "tokens": 72,
  "inputs_hash": "sha256:...",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-24T16:00:00Z",
  "redacted": true
}
```

Ravi: Infra note — we can run an AZ failover test on Dedicated. Requires reserving 2 gpus in us-east-1 + a maintenance window (30m). Estimate: 48 hours to schedule + run. We can capture KV cache behavior and tail logs for a deterministic trace. Ops will need allowlist from customer.

Maya: Cost impact?

Ravi: Ballpark:
- Reserved failover capacity (hot standby multi-AZ): +$12,000/mo
- One-time runbook & test: $2,000
- Optional telemetry connector (managed): +$1,500/mo

Sophie: Legal — we need to confirm PII redaction approach and add telemetry access clause to SOW/MSA. I can draft a short addendum but need the sample payload and retention window. Do we keep raw logs at Redwood side? If yes, how long?

Jordan: We keep raw for 7 days default; can set retention to 0/none for this account if they require. We will only ship redacted events to their Splunk.

Maya: @Ethan can you help with exec-level conversation? Lena wants firm numbers + simple proof-of-concept before she signs.

Ethan: I can jump on a call with their CTO tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need the runbook, cost delta, and a legal redline by EOD today. I'll sync with our VP.

Ravi: I'll push the runbook draft here this afternoon and ping infra-scheduling. Link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/az-failover

Lena: (forwarded from customer) If Redwood can show deterministic failover with timestamps and push events to our Splunk instance (no raw text), we can sign the pilot. We also need confirmation that egress is capped.

Maya: Noted. Action items: Jordan -> telemetry payload + retention config; Ravi -> runbook + schedule; Sophie -> addendum draft; Ethan -> exec bridge. Target: EOD for docs, call tomorrow 10am PT for sign-off. 

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance created: runbook-test-1714420000 (ETA 48h). :white_check_mark:

Jordan: putting sample CLI to configure Splunk forwarder for them:
```
redwood-cli connect --target splunk://splunk.corp --token <REDACTED> --events model.events --redact true
```

Sophie: I'll post a PR with suggested MSA wording in #legal-review and tag Maya.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll prep the pre-reads for the CTO bridge and share by 7pm PT. :thumbsup:
